name: Heap
description: Heap is a product analytics platform that "automatically captures every user interaction" so teams always have the data needed to increase conversion, retention, and customer delight.
best_for: Positioned for product teams (activation/conversion/retention), marketing teams (acquisition performance), and data teams (behavioral analysis without coding), with industry solutions for SaaS, retail/ecommerce, healthcare, and financial services.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 6 months data history; core analytics, unlimited enrichment sources, SSO; no technical support.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Custom session-based pricing; the official page only offers to install the free snippet to get an estimate. 12 months data history; adds the Sense AI assistant, unlimited users/reports.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Custom session pricing, contact required. 1 year data history (extra years a paid add-on); adds account analytics, engagement matrix, 3 projects included; session replay is a separate add-on.

tiers.name: Premier
tiers.notes: Custom session pricing, contact required. Adds data-warehouse integration, unlimited projects, a dedicated CSM, and includes session replay.

cons: No public pricing exists above the free tier -- Growth, Pro, and Premier all require contacting sales or installing the tracking snippet to get a quote, with zero indication of price ranges on the official site.
The free tier has a hard ceiling of 10,000 sessions/month and only 6 months of data history, noticeably shorter than the 12 months on Growth or the 1+ years on Pro/Premier.

Even on paid plans, capability is siloed behind further add-ons on top of the base tier price -- session replay is an add-on on Pro (only bundled free on Premier), and extra data-history years and projects beyond the included count cost more.
features: Automatic data capture via a single code snippet (no manual event tagging)
Sense AI/Sense Chat for AI-powered analytics
Integrated session replay with directed navigation to key moments

alternatives.name: Mixpanel
alternatives.description: A product intelligence platform combining analytics, session replay, experiments, and AI-powered insights.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams wanting fast, data-driven product decisions.

alternatives.name: Amplitude
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform bringing AI into product-building, with experimentation and feature management.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams needing product analytics with feature experimentation.
